title: Ops Triage: OKR Runway and All-Hands Brief (Summer Alignment)
body:
Purpose
This is a working brief to triage company-level OKRs for the summer alignment window and to land the All-Hands run-of-show, comms, and exec asks. Goal: arrive at a clean set of company objectives + 6 light-weight KRs we can commit to publicly at the All-Hands on 2025-06-25, and concrete action owners for rollouts and follow-through.

Context notes (temp, rough)
- Rapid growth on Hosted API usage; Dedicated adoption tracking behind target. Need clarity on capacity and sales ops asks.
- Private deployments pipeline: two enterprise pilots in legal review; these are gating a few enterprise revenue commitments.
- Observability: Console and Optimize feature rollouts happening in parallel; need coordinated comms so customers don’t get mixed signals about capacities and SLAs.

High-level proposed company objective drafts (pick 1–2)
Objective A: Make inference predictable and cost-competitive for production customers
  - KR1: Reduce median 99th-p95 token latency on hosted API by 15% vs baseline (June->Sep)
  - KR2: Achieve 2x throughput on Redwood Dedicated for 3 reference models under standard load tests (by Sep 30)
  - KR3: Publish a public cost-per-token benchmark matrix for top 5 verified models and regions (by Aug 15)

Objective B: Close enterprise-ready Private deployment sales & on‑board pilots safely
  - KR1: Ship V1 KMS/HSM integration and complete security checklist for 3 pilot customers (by Aug)
  - KR2: Convert 2 pilot customers to paid private licenses (by Sep 30)
  - KR3: Zero critical compliance gaps in audit run (internal readiness review complete by Jul 31)

Objective C: Developer-first adoption and platform reliability
  - KR1: Increase developer usage of the SDKs by 30% (monthly active devs) from baseline (by Sep)
  - KR2: Reduce platform incidents resulting in customer impact by 40% quarter-over-quarter
  - KR3: Launch 3 new quickstart templates and community reference apps for common patterns (chat, embeddings, reranking)

Departmental callouts (drafts for alignment)
- Eng: serving-runtime to scope prioritized kernel optimizations for the top 2 popular models; need sign-off on test harness by 2025-06-10 (owner: Jon Park).
- Infra/Platform: finalize Dedicated autoscaling policy defaults and publish recommended config docs (owner: Maya Chen).
- Product: finalize public benchmark story + PRD for cost matrix (owner: Rahul Sen).
- Sales & CS: confirm list of pilot customers and risk flags for Private (owner: Lucia Rivera).

All-Hands run-of-show (25 June, 60 minutes) — draft timeline
- 0:00–0:05 Opening (CEO) — high-level company status, topline vision: why serving matters now
- 0:05–0:15 Ops & Reliability update (SRE lead) — incidents, latency, what we fixed, what’s next
- 0:15–0:25 Product roadmap highlight (SVP Product) — Hosted, Dedicated, Private priorities + demo tease
- 0:25–0:35 OKR burns (Ava + Rahul) — present proposed company OKRs, quick explainers + ask for feedback
- 0:35–0:45 Customer story (CS) — short pilot customer testimonial or quote, or recorded clip
- 0:45–0:55 Fireside Q&A (execs) — pre-collected questions + live slot (moderated)
- 0:55–1:00 Close + immediate asks (people ops + next steps)

Pre-reads & assets (must be ready 72 hours before)
- One-pager: trimmed OKR summary (1 page) — owner: Ava — due 2025-06-22
- Exec slide deck (5 slides) — owner: Rahul — due 2025-06-22
- Demo checklist + recording (if demo) — owner: Jon — due 2025-06-20
- Speaker notes and FAQs (for managers) — owner: Maya — due 2025-06-22

Comms plan (internal + external)
- Internal: All-Hands + follow-up post with public OKR summary, link to recorded meeting, and per-team actionable tickets. Channel: #all-company + email. Timing: post within 24h of the meeting.
- External: PR/marketing TODO only after OKRs are finalized and benchmarks validated — marketing will prep a short blog + benchmark artifacts in August (owner: marketing lead, TBD).

Decision points / unresolved items (flagged)
- Which company objective do we publish? (A vs B vs C or a hybrid) — do we publish 2 objectives publicly and keep one internal? (exec decision required)
- Latency KR target: do we use median 95th vs 99th percentile? (SRE input needed by 2025-06-10)
- Public benchmarks: which model weights/quantizations are allowed in public matrix? (security/legal check for IP labeling)

Risks and mitigations
- Risk: Publishing cost matrix too early could be misleading and cause support overhead. Mitigation: publish with clear methodology and model/quantization footnotes; schedule gated blog release after QA.
- Risk: Private pilot delays block enterprise revenue. Mitigation: sales to prepare flexible offers and guardrails; product to prioritize security checklist items.

Immediate next steps (this doc is an action list)
- By 2025-06-06: finalize selected company objectives (A/B/C) for draft announcement (owner: exec team)
- By 2025-06-10: SRE to confirm latency metric and measurement plan (owner: Jon)
- By 2025-06-12: Draft one-pager + slide deck first pass (owners: Ava + Rahul)
- 2025-06-20: Final demo + rehearse (owners: Jon + Maya)
- 2025-06-22: All pre-read assets published (owners: Ava, Rahul, Maya)
- 2025-06-25: All-Hands (present & publish summary)

Notes to self / open comments (working doc behavior)
- Keep this doc lightweight. We’ll move the final materials to Confluence under CONF-2142 and link here when ready.
- Invite execs to a 30-min dry run on 2025-06-23.
- Need a short manager Q&A script (3–4 lines) for local team syncs after the All-Hands.

Action items (shallow)
- Rahul: pull current Dedicated throughput numbers and annotated issues list (due 6/5).
- Jon: list top 3 kernel optimizations and estimate perf delta (due 6/9).
- Maya: draft manager FAQ + comms template (due 6/18).
- Lucia: surface pilot legal risk items and escalate if needed (ongoing).

If you’re reading and want to help: add quick comments inline or ping me in Slack (Ava). We’ll iterate quickly and lock public commitments 72h before the All-Hands.

-- end of brief --
